rows.reply_en:
Hello,

You can swap a shift by opening the shift in the app and tapping "Offer swap". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. The manager approves the request under Rota → Requests (Rooster → Verzoeken). Manager approval is turned on by default; this can be turned off under Settings → Rota (Instellingen → Rooster).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
rows.verified_en: Hello, You can swap a shift by opening the shift in the app and tapping "Ruil aanbieden". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. Hello,

The Plus plan costs €6 per active employee per month (excluding VAT). For 25 active employees, this comes to €150 per month, excluding VAT. You can upgrade at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
